title: Pre-Operative Electrocardiogram Tracing Rate — Insurance Claim (Third-Party Billing)
content:
The tracing code 93005 under revenue code 0730, billed on the Hospital Account (Encounter Billing) of an outpatient surgery whose post-payment denial is refunded on an Insurance Claim (Third-Party Billing), is valued per counted unit at:

- **Commercial PPO Claim:** 28.00 USD per counted unit.
- **Commercial HMO Claim:** 34.00 USD per counted unit.
- **Otherwise (a Marketplace Exchange Plan Claim):** its charges per counted unit times the payer class's expected allowed percentage.

The tracing is valued at its counted units times that rate, never above its charges, its counted units being its billed units, or one when it is billed with charges but no units.

**Basis questions**
- *Two tracings on a Commercial HMO Claim with charges of 150.00?* 2 times 34.00, so 68.00.
- *One tracing on a Commercial PPO Claim with charges of 20.00?* 28.00 is above the charges, so 20.00.
- *A tracing line with charges but no units?* It counts as one unit.
(All figures in these answers are hypothetical.)
